name: cloudru-ai-monitoring-assistant
description: Coursework MVP: AI assistant overlay for application incident triage.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @coursework/api" "npm run dev --workspace @coursework/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @coursework/shared && npm run build --workspace @coursework/api && npm run build --workspace @coursework/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @coursework/api && npm run test --workspace @coursework/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @coursework/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @coursework/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @coursework/web
